name: Ueno (Gunma, Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Ueno village emblem in white: a ring divided by a vertical bar, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ueno, a village in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1971.

features.role: Ueno village emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar, enclosing a stylised character
